metadata.title: iRECIST: guidelines for response criteria for use in trials testing immunotherapeutics.

readingScope: Introduction and Terminology: irRECIST naming was inconsistent; iRECIST is a separately standardized framework including iUPD/iCPD. No trial taxonomy is assigned from this guideline alone.

primaryTextReading.retrievalMethod: web.run open and find(irRECIST), parsed readable primary article returned in this session
primaryTextReading.shortVerbatimExcerpt: These recommendations are often referred to as irRECIST, but have not always been consistently applied
primaryTextReading.otherReadObservation: Terminology, parsed line250, distinguishes unconfirmed progression iUPD and confirmed progression iCPD.
primaryTextReading.receiptScope: This is a record of the actual web-tool text read; no raw HTTP body bytes or digest were provided for that text. The other response digest in this file covers EuropePMC metadata only. A later browser-check response does not reproduce this earlier parsed view.
